ahrq pqi 90 overall composite.definition: AHRQ’s area-level rate of preventable hospital discharges among residents aged 18 and older, reported per 100,000 population. It combines qualifying discharges for the component PQIs, counting a discharge only once even if it qualifies for multiple components.
ahrq pqi 90 overall composite.numerator: Qualifying discharges for PQIs 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, and 16 under the applicable specifications; duplicate discharges across components count once.
ahrq pqi 90 overall composite.denominator: Population aged 18 and older in the metropolitan area or county, assigned by the patient’s residence.
exclusions: Discharges excluded by the component PQI numerator rules.
ahrq pqi 90 overall composite.steward: AHRQ, Prevention Quality Indicators (PQI) #90, Version 5.0 (March 2015); current AHRQ listing identifies Version 2025.

hcc recapture rate.definition: In common industry usage, the rate is the share of prior-year HCCs that are documented again in the current year; it is a tracking convention, not an exact CMS-published measure definition. The calculation may vary by program, including which prior-year conditions count and whether the unit is HCCs or members.
hcc recapture rate.numerator: Prior-year HCCs documented again in the current year
hcc recapture rate.denominator: HCCs documented in the prior year and selected for recapture under the reporting convention
hcc recapture rate.period: Prior year compared with the current calendar year; specific lookback varies by convention
hcc recapture rate.steward: Industry convention; no CMS, NCQA, AHRQ, or PQA measure specification identified in the available sources

hedis breast cancer screening bcs e.definition: NCQA HEDIS measure of the percentage of women ages 50–74 who are recommended for routine breast cancer screening and have a mammogram during the specified screening window.
hedis breast cancer screening bcs e.numerator: Women with one or more mammograms from October 1 two years before the measurement period through the end of the measurement period.
hedis breast cancer screening bcs e.denominator: Eligible women ages 52–74 by the end of the measurement period who are recommended for routine breast cancer screening, before exclusions.
exclusions: Bilateral mastectomy or both right and left unilateral mastectomies at any time through the measurement-period end
Gender-affirming chest surgery with a diagnosis of gender dysphoria
For members 66 and older, applicable institutional SNP enrollment or long-term institutional residence
For members 66 and older, both frailty and advanced illness
Palliative care during the measurement year
Hospice use or hospice benefit election during the measurement year
hedis breast cancer screening bcs e.period: Mammogram window: October 1 two years before the measurement period through its end; the cited 2025 guide describes the measurement period as the measurement year.
hedis breast cancer screening bcs e.steward: NCQA, HEDIS Breast Cancer Screening (BCS-E), Measurement Year 2025; NCQA technical specifications govern the measure.

mssp avoidable spend.definition: No CMS or other measure steward definition for the exact term “MSSP avoidable spend” was identified. In common ACO industry usage, it refers to spending on unnecessary or avoidable services or utilization that an ACO seeks to reduce; this is not a standardized MSSP measure and is distinct from CMS-calculated savings against an ACO benchmark.
mssp avoidable spend.steward: No steward-defined measure or specification identified; industry convention, sources dated 2020–2024
